newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Proview says to offer 130 mln shrs in IPO.
newsitem.headline: HK's Proview says to offer 130 mln shrs in IPO.

text.p: Colour and monochrome computer monitor maker and distributor Proview International Holdings Ltd said on Monday it is offering 130 million new shares at HK$1.12 each in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong.
The issue price represents a price earnings multiple of 7.23 times on a fully-diluted basis and 5.89 times on a weighted average basis.
The IPO will run from June 4 to 10 and dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin on June 18.
Lippo Securities is the sponsor and manager of the issue.
Net proceeds of about HK$131.10 million will mainly be used to buy a new factory building and additional production facilities of its existing manufacturing plant.
Part of the proceeds will also be used to develop new products such as 20-inch and 21-inch colour monitor.
Proview forecast profit after taxation and minority interests but before extraordinary items of not less than HK$75 million for the year ending in June 30, 1997.
The company posted a profit of HK$49.89 million for the year ended in June, 1996, up from HK$35.55 million in 1995 and HK$30.15 in 1994.
Turnover was at HK$1.15 billion in 1996, against HK$799.92 million in 1995 and HK$645.49 million in 1994.
The company is engaged in the design, manufacture and sell of computer monitors.
